_comment: Derived from the bone names and rest positions in scene.gltf (hartwelkisaka, CC-BY-4.0). Front = camera side. TODO(HUMAN-VERIFY): confirm FR/FL/RR/RL visually in Unreal before trusting.
spin_axis: bone-local up axis (vertical through the hub); confirm in Unreal by watching one prop
camera_front_hint: camera bones sit on the +Z side in the glTF, which is the vehicle front
notes: Spinning bones: prop, nut, cap and bolt per motor. If the motor bell looks wrong, add motor_N_jnt to that motor's spin list and re-test.
Rotate bones with UPoseableMeshComponent::SetBoneRotationByName each tick; do not use the baked animations.
Spin direction per motor comes from motor_spin in vehicle_config.json (config order FR, FL, RR, RL).
Scale the mesh so the distance between motor axes matches the arm length in vehicle_config.json.
